rules: finite positive retained full-fit amplitude, centroid, major/minor FWHM

controls: balanced same-direction odd/even-within-direction null partition (not scan-index parity classification)
left/right counts, coverage, angle, speed, and normalized weight
left/right major/minor FWHM, ellipticity, and amplitude
timing dependence on realized speed reported; limited leverage disposition required

direction_classifier.hold_rule: both adjacent native raw Hold words exactly zero and equal; otherwise exclude
direction_classifier.measurement_window: central 80 percent of each admitted compatibility-science window
direction_classifier.stable_sign_rule: at least 99 percent of projected samples in the direction window have the robust-median sign
direction_classifier.threshold_rule: one half the minimum absolute robust median projected speed over all admitted windows

limited_feasibility_pilot.confirmatory_inference: excluded from every confirmatory population and result
limited_feasibility_pilot.nonblind_limitation: eight pilot detector direction differences were visible before this freeze
limited_feasibility_pilot.use: debug coordinate reconstruction and confirm fit viability only

pooled_fit.coordinate: each detector translated by its retained full-fit centroid; translation cancels in left-right difference
pooled_fit.groups: all arrays pooled, each array, each detector network/interface
pooled_fit.normalization: signal divided by retained positive full-fit amplitude; equal detector contribution

positive_scan_axis.derivation: principal eigenvector of admitted-window robust median realized velocity vectors
positive_scan_axis.sign: dot product positive with configured Rectilinear Map.ScanAngle unit vector

primary_estimator.detection_rule: 95 percent interval excludes zero and controls are timing-compatible
primary_estimator.global_tolerance: none; result is a measurement, not ALIGN acceptance
primary_estimator.intervals: normal-equivalent 68 percent = estimate +/- 1 SE; 95 percent = estimate +/- 1.96 SE
primary_estimator.speed: actual instantaneous trajectory projected speed for the exact retained fit samples
primary_estimator.uncertainty: delete-one-stable-scan jackknife of the pooled normalized 1-arcsec diagnostic map
primary_estimator.upper_bound_rule: only when 95 percent interval includes zero and controls/coverage are acceptable: max(abs(interval endpoints))

sample_selection.hold: both adjacent raw words zero and no transition ambiguity
sample_selection.radial_window: distance from retained full-fit centroid <= 4 times retained major FWHM
sample_selection.scan: must be selected in frozen direction registry

separate_fit.center_bounds: retained full-fit centroid plus/minus retained major FWHM on each tangent axis
separate_fit.loss_scale: max(0.2 times prefit signal standard deviation, 1e-12)
separate_fit.matched_population: intersection passing identical frozen quality rules in both directions
separate_fit.model: elliptical 2D Gaussian plus tangent-plane affine background
separate_fit.quality: solver success, finite covariance, amplitude / residual MAD-sigma >= 3, non-boundary center and widths
